items.problem: 12x CS0579 'Duplicate System.Reflection.Assembly*Attribute' errors caused by the UWP project's Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs being carried into the migrated tree, where the SDK-style WinUI csproj auto-generates the same attributes.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~line 6093 (CS0579 errors) and ~6185 (agent fix '<GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo>'; narrative: 'CustomEffect\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs conflicts with the SDK-generated one').
items.root_cause: Classic (non-SDK-style) UWP projects ship a Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs with [assembly: AssemblyVersion], [assembly: ComVisible], etc. SDK-style projects auto-generate these, so the copied file produces duplicate-attribute errors. Neither Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 nor the docs handle it.
items.proposed_fix: Tier 1: exclude AssemblyInfo.cs in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's copy filter (mirror the bin/obj skip). Tier 3: add a 'Common build errors' entry for CS0579 with the delete-AssemblyInfo / GenerateAssemblyInfo=false fix.
items.generalizes: Virtually every classic UWP project has Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs, so this duplicate-attribute collision recurs on any UWP->WinUI 3 migration that copies source verbatim.
